response.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), stats AS (SELECT mix, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER ()) OVER () AS avg_share FROM base) SELECT mix, cnt, share, share - avg_share AS above_avg FROM stats WHERE share > avg_share
